verdict.rationale: Mercury says Books is 'built to replace' QuickBooks and other tools, but no evidence documents importing or migrating historical ledgers, journal entries, or transaction detail from another accounting system. The QuickBooks, NetSuite and Xero integrations push Mercury data out to those ledgers, which is the opposite direction. Linking external bank accounts and platforms is an ongoing feed, not a migration of historical books. These are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can migrate historical books from another accounting system without losing transaction detail
